label: Master's
heading: Master's students
intro: Master's students can get involved in lab projects as opportunities arise; these depend on the needs of our current projects. First check your Penn State program's requirements, then email Xinning Gui or Yubo Kou and include:
steps: Which of our research areas or projects interests you, and why.
The research methods and topics you want to work on.
Whether you are looking for a funded position or a volunteer role, and how much time you can contribute.
